name: ATK_WATCHLIST_ITEMS
description: Watchlist User Items: stores the actual watchlist item counts against users or roles.

columns.name: WATCHLIST_ITEM_CODE
columns.description: Watchlist Item Code: references the item code from the watchlist setup table (ATK_WATCHLIST_SETUP.WATCHLIST_ITEM_CODE).

columns.name: WATCHLIST_ITEM_NAME
columns.description: User-created saved search name. Required if WATCHLIST_ITEM_TYPE = USER_SAVED_SEARCH for this item in setup table.

columns.name: SAVED_SEARCH_VIEW_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for user-created saved search. Required if WATCHLIST_ITEM_TYPE = USER_SAVED_SEARCH for this item in setup table.

columns.name: REFRESH_STATUS
columns.description: Indicates the status of last refresh request for this item. Valid values are PENDING and COMPLETE. Required if WATCHLIST_ITEM_TYPE != TXN_FLOW_BASED.

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_REQUEST_TIME
columns.description: Date and time of the last refresh request for this item. Required if WATCHLIST_ITEM_TYPE != TXN_FLOW_BASED.

columns.name: ITEM_COUNT
columns.description: The actual count for this item shown to the user in Watchlist UI. Required if REFRESH_STATUS != PENDING (empty only during initial refresh request for user).

columns.name: LAST_REFRESH_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Watchlist item counts are calculated periodically by the product web services.This column represents the date when the item was last refreshed.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to determine if the category has been disabled by the user using the watchlist preferences UI.

columns.name: ITEM_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to determine if the watchlist itesm has been disabled by the user using the watchlist preferences UI.

columns.name: ENABLE_ZERO_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: This flag is used to identify whether the items with zero count are shown or hidden.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
